stem.text: A calibration curve is shown for an ammeter whose scale is inaccurate.

stem.alt: Graph of ammeter reading in mA (vertical axis, 0 to 0.6) against current in mA (horizontal axis, 0 to 0.6), showing one curve rising from the origin region to the top right.

stem.text: Two readings taken on the meter at different times during an experiment are $0.13\,\text{mA}$ and $0.47\,\text{mA}$.
By how much did the current really increase between taking the two readings?
